pr.title: feat(dcp): dopemux dcp CLI group v1 (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-107)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds `dopemux dcp` click group with subcommands per design D-G: preflight, status, red-lines, verify-proof, receipts (list/show/verify).
- All commands support `--json` for machine-readable output and `--tp` with sanitizer regex `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` before any path construction (no traversal).
- Every invocation emits a helper receipt via the TP-106 emitter.
- `red-lines` exits non-zero when BLOCKED findings are present.
- CLI group registered in cli.py via lazy/guarded import per amendment A9 — DCP import failures cannot brick unrelated commands; name-conflict precheck on registration.
- `dopemux --help` startup time is validated as unchanged.

## Validation
- CLI integration tests covering all subcommands.
- Receipt emitted per invocation verified.
- red-lines non-zero exit on BLOCKED confirmed.
- `dopemux --help` timing regression check.

## NOT_RUN
- evidence-pack subcommand (TP-108).
- accept subcommand (TP-110).
- resource-map subcommand (TP-111).

steps.task: Preflight: inspect cli.py structure and import pattern, confirm TP-103 loader and TP-106 receipts emitter are present, check for any existing 'dcp' group name conflict.
commands: python -c "import dopemux.dcp.receipts" && echo 'receipts ok' || echo 'receipts missing'
python -c "from dopemux.dcp.red_lane_rules import load_taxonomy" && echo 'loader ok' || echo 'loader missing'
validation: cli.py line count and import style documented.
TP-103 load_taxonomy and TP-106 receipts emitter importable.

steps.task: Create src/dopemux/dcp/cli_dcp.py with the dcp click group and all v1 subcommands. Implement: (1) dcp preflight — git posture, policy/taxonomy version check, instance-file validity, SnapshotBlocked check; (2) dcp status — generate_control_snapshot() summary; (3) dcp red-lines [--files FILE...] [--diff] [--tp TP_ID] — wraps RedLaneScanner.scan(), exits non-zero on BLOCKED; (4) dcp verify-proof <tp_or_path> — runs proof.validate_proof_file + scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py + receipt chain verify; (5) dcp receipts list|show|verify — receipt store reader. All subcommands: --json flag, --tp sanitized to ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ before any path construction, emit receipt per invocation.

Register the dcp group in src/dopemux/cli.py using lazy/guarded import. The registration must: (1) attempt import inside a try/except so ImportError cannot propagate to the main CLI; (2) log a warning if DCP group unavailable; (3) check for name collision before add_command; (4) not add any eager import at module top level.
validation: python -c "import dopemux.cli" exits 0 even with dopemux.dcp.cli_dcp temporarily moved.

steps.task: Validate startup time: run `time dopemux --help` before and after the dcp group registration. The delta must be under 100ms. If cli.py uses lazy import correctly, the delta should be near-zero since DCP module is not loaded on --help.
validation: `dopemux --help` startup time delta is under 100ms or within 10% of baseline.
